mapper.sql: ID, DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, FLOW_COUNT, FLOW_DIRECTION, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow, AVG(FLOW_COUNT) as avgFlow, MAX(FLOW_COUNT) as maxFlow, MIN(FLOW_COUNT) as minFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT FLOW_DIRECTION as direction, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY FLOW_DIRECTION

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM RECORD_TIME) as hour, SUM(FLOW_COUNT) as totalFlow, AVG(FLOW_COUNT) as avgFlow, MAX(FLOW_COUNT) as maxFlow FROM CLOUDWALK.FLOW_ANALYSIS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM RECORD_TIME) ORDER BY hour
